title: agentic.representations.v1 response
description: Body returned by a self-operated representation endpoint. Exactly one data entry per request input, in request order, carrying exactly the requested representations.

spaces.description: One descriptor per populated representation kind. A consumer persists the id beside the values and refuses to query an index built under a different one.

id.description: Stable opaque identifier. For an opaque endpoint it is immutable deployment configuration, not something the handler derives at runtime.

revision.description: Immutable model weights revision. Empty means the deployment could not prove one, which is itself information: a silent model swap cannot then be detected.

tokenizer.description: Immutable tokenizer and vocabulary revision. It matters most for sparse output, where the indices are vocabulary positions.

dimensions.description: Vector width for dense, vocabulary size for sparse, per-token width for multi_vector.

multi_vector.description: One vector per token, for late-interaction scoring. Not a dense vector waiting to be pooled.

sparse.description: Coordinate form. Indices are strictly increasing and within the space's declared vocabulary; values are finite and nonzero.

usage.description: Measurements, not money. Combine them with a dated external price catalog.
